items.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.

hints.he: החלק של if מתאר מצב אפשרי בעתיד. מה קורה בחלק השני?
hints.en: The if part is a real future possibility. What happens in the other part?

hints.he: בחלק של התוצאה משתמשים ב־will ואחריו פועל בסיס.
hints.en: The result part uses will + base verb.

explanation.he: תנאי ראשון: If + הווה פשוט, will + פועל בסיס. זה מצב אמיתי ואפשרי בעתיד.
explanation.en: First conditional: If + Present Simple, will + base verb. It is a real future possibility.

items.audioText: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

items.prompt: If you ___ hard, you will pass the exam.

hints.en: Do not use will after if.

hints.he: איזה זמן בא אחרי if בתנאי ראשון?
hints.en: Which tense comes after if in the first conditional?

explanation.he: בעברית אומרים 'אם אלמד', בזמן עתיד. באנגלית אחרי if משתמשים בהווה פשוט: If you study.
explanation.en: In Hebrew the if part is in the future. In English, use the Present Simple after if: If you study.

items.audioText: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.

items.prompt: If she ___ the bus, she will be late. (miss)

feedback.he: אחרי if לא משתמשים ב־will. צריך הווה פשוט.
feedback.en: No will after if. Use the Present Simple.

feedback.he: כמעט. עם she מוסיפים es.
feedback.en: Almost. With she, add -es.

hints.he: אחרי if משתמשים בהווה פשוט. מי הנושא?
hints.en: After if, use the Present Simple. Who is the subject?

explanation.he: If + הווה פשוט. she בהווה פשוט מקבלת s, ואחרי ss מוסיפים es: misses.
explanation.en: If + Present Simple. With she, add -s. After ss we add -es: misses.

items.audioText: If she misses the bus, she will be late.

items.prompt: We won't go to the beach if the weather ___ bad.

hints.he: החלק של if יכול לבוא גם בסוף המשפט.
hints.en: The if part can also come at the end.

hints.he: גם כשהוא בסוף, אחרי if בא הווה פשוט.
hints.en: Even at the end, use the Present Simple after if.

explanation.he: לא משנה איפה if נמצא במשפט: אחריו בא הווה פשוט, the weather is, ולא will be.
explanation.en: Wherever the if part is, it takes the Present Simple: the weather is, not will be.

items.audioText: We won't go to the beach if the weather is bad.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: If I see Dana, I will give her the book.
If I will see Dana, I will give her the book.
If I saw Dana, I will give her the book.
If I see Dana, I would gave her the book.

hints.en: Check the verb after if.

hints.he: תנאי ראשון: If + הווה פשוט, will + פועל בסיס.
hints.en: First conditional: If + Present Simple, will + base verb.

explanation.he: If I see ..., I will give ... זה המבנה של תנאי ראשון. will לא בא אחרי if, ולא מערבבים עבר עם will.
explanation.en: If I see ..., I will give ... is the first conditional. No will after if, and do not mix the past with will.

items.audioText: If I see Dana, I will give her the book.

items.prompt: If you heat ice, it ___.

hints.en: This is a scientific fact that is always true.

hints.he: לעובדות כלליות משתמשים בהווה פשוט בשני החלקים.
hints.en: For general facts, use the Present Simple in both parts.

explanation.he: תנאי אפס: לעובדה שתמיד נכונה משתמשים ב־If + הווה פשוט, הווה פשוט. it מקבל s: it melts.
explanation.en: Zero conditional: for facts that are always true, use If + Present Simple, Present Simple. it takes -s: it melts.

items.audioText: If you heat ice, it melts.

items.prompt: איזה משפט מתאר מצב דמיוני בהווה?

options.text: If I had wings, I would fly to school.
If it rains, we will stay inside.
If you mix red and white, you get pink.
If I had seen him, I would have said hello.

hints.he: מצב דמיוני בהווה בנוי מ־If + עבר פשוט, would + פועל בסיס.
hints.en: An imaginary present situation: If + Past Simple, would + base verb.

hints.he: משפט אחד מדבר על עבר שכבר נגמר. הוא לא התשובה.
hints.en: One sentence is about a finished past. It is not the answer.

explanation.he: If I had wings, I would fly הוא תנאי שני: מצב לא אמיתי עכשיו. If it rains הוא תנאי ראשון (אפשרי), mix ... get הוא עובדה (תנאי אפס), ו־had seen ... would have said הוא תנאי שלישי (עבר).
explanation.en: If I had wings, I would fly is the second conditional: not real now. If it rains is first (possible), mix ... get is a fact (zero), had seen ... would have said is third (past).

items.prompt: If I ___ a million shekels, I would buy a house by the sea.

hints.he: יש לי מיליון שקל? כנראה שלא. זה חלום.
hints.en: Do I really have a million shekels? Probably not. It is a dream.

hints.he: בחלק של if בתנאי שני משתמשים בעבר פשוט.
hints.en: In the second conditional, the if part uses the Past Simple.

explanation.he: תנאי שני מתאר מצב דמיוני: If + עבר פשוט, would + פועל בסיס. העבר כאן לא מדבר על זמן עבר, הוא מראה שזה לא אמיתי.
explanation.en: The second conditional is for imaginary situations: If + Past Simple, would + base verb. The past form shows it is not real, not past time.

items.audioText: If I had a million shekels, I would buy a house by the sea.

items.prompt: If I ___ you, I would talk to the teacher. (be)

feedback.he: זה לא מצב אמיתי. אני לא אתה. צריך צורת עבר.
feedback.en: This is not real. I am not you. Use a past form.

feedback.he: would בא בחלק של התוצאה, לא אחרי if.
feedback.en: would goes in the result part, not after if.

hints.he: אני באמת אתה? מצב דמיוני דורש עבר.
hints.en: Am I really you? An imaginary situation needs a past form.

explanation.he: If I were you הוא ביטוי קבוע לנתינת עצה. בתנאי שני נהוג were גם עם I, וזו הצורה המומלצת במבחן.
explanation.en: If I were you is a fixed phrase for advice. In the second conditional, were is used even with I. It is the best form for exams.

items.audioText: If I were you, I would talk to the teacher.

items.prompt: If my grandmother lived closer, we ___ her every week.

hints.he: lived בא אחרי if. איזה סוג תנאי זה?
hints.en: lived comes after if. Which conditional is this?

hints.he: If + עבר פשוט הולך עם would + פועל בסיס.
hints.en: If + Past Simple goes with would + base verb.

explanation.he: סבתא לא גרה קרוב. זה מצב דמיוני, ולכן תנאי שני: If she lived ..., we would visit.
explanation.en: Grandmother does not live close. It is imaginary, so it is the second conditional: If she lived ..., we would visit.

items.audioText: If my grandmother lived closer, we would visit her every week.

items.prompt: What ___ you do if you found a wallet in the street?

hints.he: found בא אחרי if. זה מצב אמיתי או דמיוני?
hints.en: found comes after if. Is it real or imaginary?

hints.he: בשאלה בתנאי שני would בא לפני הנושא.
hints.en: In a second conditional question, would comes before the subject.

explanation.he: שואלים על מצב דמיוני: if you found, ולכן What would you do. would מתאים לתנאי שני.
explanation.en: It is an imaginary situation: if you found, so What would you do. would fits the second conditional.

items.audioText: What would you do if you found a wallet in the street?

items.prompt: If he ___ so much time on his phone, he would sleep better. (not spend)

instruction.he: להשלים את החסר (מילה אחת או שתיים)
instruction.en: Fill in the gap (one or two words)

feedback.he: התוצאה היא would sleep, ולכן בחלק של if צריך עבר.
feedback.en: The result is would sleep, so the if part needs the past.

feedback.he: לא שמים would אחרי if.
feedback.en: Do not use would after if.

hints.he: החלק השני הוא would sleep. איזה זמן בא אחרי if?
hints.en: The other part is would sleep. Which tense comes after if?

explanation.he: תנאי שני בשלילה: If + didn't + פועל בסיס, would + פועל בסיס.
explanation.en: Negative second conditional: If + didn't + base verb, would + base verb.

items.audioText: If he didn't spend so much time on his phone, he would sleep better.

items.prompt: If I could fly, I ___ to Japan for breakfast.

hints.he: could בא אחרי if. אפשר באמת לעוף?
hints.en: could comes after if. Can people really fly?
After would, use the base verb.

explanation.he: מצב דמיוני, ולכן would + פועל בסיס: would go. אחרי would לא בא פועל בעבר.
explanation.en: It is imaginary, so would + base verb: would go. Never a past verb after would.

items.audioText: If I could fly, I would go to Japan for breakfast.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: If we had more time, we would visit the museum.
If we would have more time, we would visit the museum.
If we have more time, we would visit the museum.
If we had more time, we will visit the museum.

hints.he: לבדוק את שני החלקים: מה בא אחרי if ומה בא בתוצאה?
hints.en: Check both parts: what comes after if, and what is in the result?
would appears in one part only.

explanation.he: תנאי שני: If + עבר פשוט (had), would + פועל בסיס (would visit). לא שמים would אחרי if ולא מערבבים הווה עם would.
explanation.en: Second conditional: If + Past Simple (had), would + base verb (would visit). No would after if, and no present with would.

items.audioText: If we had more time, we would visit the museum.

items.prompt: I don't have a car. If I ___ a car, I would drive you to the airport.

hints.he: למשפט הראשון יש רמז: I don't have a car.
hints.en: The first sentence is a clue: I don't have a car.

hints.he: מצב לא אמיתי בהווה: עבר פשוט אחרי if.
hints.en: Not real now: Past Simple after if.

explanation.he: אין לי מכונית, ולכן זה מצב דמיוני: If I had a car, I would drive you.
explanation.en: I have no car, so it is imaginary: If I had a car, I would drive you.

items.audioText: I don't have a car. If I had a car, I would drive you to the airport.

items.prompt: If I ___ a dog, I would walk it every day. (have)

feedback.he: התוצאה היא would walk, ולכן צריך עבר אחרי if.
feedback.en: The result is would walk, so use the past after if.

feedback.he: would בא רק בחלק של התוצאה.
feedback.en: would goes only in the result part.

hints.he: would walk הוא רמז לתנאי שני.
hints.en: would walk is a clue for the second conditional.

explanation.he: תנאי שני: If I had a dog, I would walk it. have בעבר הוא had.
explanation.en: Second conditional: If I had a dog, I would walk it. The past of have is had.

items.audioText: If I had a dog, I would walk it every day.

items.prompt: If we had left earlier, we ___ the train.

hints.he: had left מדבר על עבר שכבר נגמר.
hints.en: had left is about a finished past.
The past result: would have + V3.

explanation.he: תנאי שלישי מדבר על עבר שלא קרה: If + had + V3, would have + V3. לא יצאנו מוקדם, ולא תפסנו את הרכבת.
explanation.en: The third conditional is about a past that did not happen: If + had + V3, would have + V3. We did not leave early and did not catch the train.

items.audioText: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.

items.prompt: If you ___ me, I would have helped you.

hints.he: would have helped הוא רמז: זה עבר שלא קרה.
hints.en: would have helped is a clue: a past that did not happen.

hints.he: אחרי if בתנאי שלישי: had + V3.
hints.en: After if in the third conditional: had + V3.

explanation.he: בתנאי שלישי החלק של if הוא Past Perfect: had asked. לא שמים would אחרי if.
explanation.en: In the third conditional, the if part is Past Perfect: had asked. No would after if.

items.audioText: If you had asked me, I would have helped you.

items.prompt: If she had studied, she ___ the test. (pass)

instruction.he: להשלים את החסר (מילה אחת או שתיים)
instruction.en: Fill in the gap (one or two words)

feedback.he: had studied מדבר על עבר. התוצאה צריכה להיות would have + V3.
feedback.en: had studied is about the past. The result needs would have + V3.

feedback.he: had + V3 בא בחלק של if. בתוצאה צריך would have.
feedback.en: had + V3 goes in the if part. The result needs would have.

hints.he: זה עבר שלא קרה. איך בונים תוצאה בעבר?
hints.en: It is a past that did not happen. How do we build a past result?
Three words: would + have + V3.

explanation.he: תנאי שלישי: If + had + V3, would have + V3. pass בצורה שלישית הוא passed.
explanation.en: Third conditional: If + had + V3, would have + V3. The V3 of pass is passed.

items.audioText: If she had studied, she would have passed the test.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: If I had known about the party, I would have come.
If I would have known about the party, I would have come.
If I had known about the party, I would come.
If I have known about the party, I would have come.

hints.en: This is the past: the party already happened.

hints.he: If + had + V3, would have + V3.
hints.en: If + had + V3, would have + V3.

explanation.he: לא ידעתי על המסיבה ולא באתי. תנאי שלישי: If I had known ..., I would have come. would לא בא אחרי if.
explanation.en: I did not know and did not come. Third conditional: If I had known ..., I would have come. No would after if.

items.audioText: If I had known about the party, I would have come.

items.prompt: He didn't wear a coat, so he got sick. If he ___ a coat, he wouldn't have got sick.

hints.he: המשפט הראשון בעבר. זה כבר קרה.
hints.en: The first sentence is in the past. It already happened.

hints.he: צריך had + V3. wear, wore, worn.
hints.en: You need had + V3. wear, wore, worn.

explanation.he: חרטה על העבר: If he had worn a coat, he wouldn't have got sick. worn הוא V3 של wear.
explanation.en: Regret about the past: If he had worn a coat, he wouldn't have got sick. worn is the V3 of wear.

items.audioText: He didn't wear a coat, so he got sick. If he had worn a coat, he wouldn't have got sick.

items.prompt: We ___ the game if our best player hadn't been injured. (win)

instruction.he: להשלים את החסר (מילה אחת או שתיים)
instruction.en: Fill in the gap (one or two words)

feedback.he: hadn't been מדבר על העבר. צריך would have + V3.
feedback.en: hadn't been is about the past. You need would have + V3.

feedback.he: אחרי have צריך V3: won.
feedback.en: After have, use V3: won.

hints.he: החלק של if נמצא בסוף. מה הזמן שלו?
hints.en: The if part is at the end. What tense is it?
win, won, won.

explanation.he: תנאי שלישי: would have + V3 בתוצאה. win בצורה שלישית הוא won.
explanation.en: Third conditional: would have + V3 in the result. The V3 of win is won.

items.audioText: We would have won the game if our best player hadn't been injured.

items.prompt: I wish I ___ taller.

hints.he: אני לא גבוה. זו משאלה על ההווה.
hints.en: I am not tall. This is a wish about the present.

hints.he: משאלה על ההווה: עבר אחרי wish.
hints.en: A wish about now: past form after wish.

explanation.he: I wish + עבר פשוט מבטא משאלה על ההווה. עם be משתמשים ב־were (גם was נשמע בדיבור).
explanation.en: I wish + Past Simple is a wish about the present. With be we use were (was is heard in speech).

items.audioText: I wish I were taller.

items.prompt: I wish I ___ to the party last night. It was amazing.

hints.he: last night: זו חרטה על העבר.
hints.en: last night: this is a regret about the past.
Regret about the past: had + V3.

explanation.he: משאלה על העבר בונים עם I wish + had + V3: I wish I had gone. בעברית: הלוואי שהייתי הולך.
explanation.en: A wish about the past: I wish + had + V3: I wish I had gone.

items.audioText: I wish I had gone to the party last night. It was amazing.

items.prompt: I wish I ___ how to swim. (know)

feedback.he: אחרי wish לא משתמשים בהווה. צריך להזיז אחורה לעבר.
feedback.en: Do not use the present after wish. Move it back to the past.

feedback.he: זו משאלה על עכשיו, לא על העבר. מספיק עבר פשוט.
feedback.en: This wish is about now, not the past. Use the Past Simple.

hints.he: אני לא יודע/ת לשחות עכשיו. מה בא אחרי wish?
hints.en: I can't swim now. What comes after wish?

explanation.he: משאלה על ההווה: I wish + עבר פשוט. know בעבר הוא knew.
explanation.en: A wish about now: I wish + Past Simple. The past of know is knew.

items.audioText: I wish I knew how to swim.

items.prompt: If only you ___ me the truth yesterday!

hints.en: yesterday: regret about the past.

hints.he: If only עובד כמו I wish.
hints.en: If only works like I wish.

explanation.he: If only הוא I wish חזק יותר. על העבר: had + V3. If only you had told me.
explanation.en: If only is a stronger I wish. About the past: had + V3. If only you had told me.

items.audioText: If only you had told me the truth yesterday!

items.prompt: I wish my neighbours ___ so much noise. I can't sleep.

hints.he: זו תלונה על מה שאנשים אחרים עושים.
hints.en: This is a complaint about what other people do.

hints.he: כשרוצים שמישהו אחר ישנה התנהגות: wish + would.
hints.en: To want someone else to change: wish + would.

explanation.he: כשמתלוננים על הרגל של מישהו אחר משתמשים ב־I wish + someone + would / wouldn't + פועל בסיס.
explanation.en: To complain about someone else's habit: I wish + someone + would / wouldn't + base verb.

items.audioText: I wish my neighbours wouldn't make so much noise. I can't sleep.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: I wish I had more free time.
I wish I have more free time.
I wish I would have more free time.
I wish I will have more free time.

hints.en: This is a wish about the present.
wish + Past Simple.

explanation.he: I wish I had: משאלה על עכשיו. לא משתמשים בהווה, ב־will, או ב־would כשמדברים על עצמנו.
explanation.en: I wish I had: a wish about now. Do not use the present, will, or would about yourself.

items.audioText: I wish I had more free time.

items.prompt: She failed the test. She wishes she ___ harder. (study)

instruction.he: להשלים את החסר (מילה אחת או שתיים)
instruction.en: Fill in the gap (one or two words)

feedback.he: המבחן כבר היה. על העבר צריך had + V3.
feedback.en: The test is over. For the past, use had + V3.

feedback.he: אחרי wish לא משתמשים בהווה.
feedback.en: Do not use the present after wish.

hints.he: היא כבר נכשלה. זו חרטה על העבר.
hints.en: She already failed. This is a regret about the past.

explanation.he: חרטה על העבר: wish + had + V3. She wishes she had studied harder.
explanation.en: Regret about the past: wish + had + V3. She wishes she had studied harder.

items.audioText: She failed the test. She wishes she had studied harder.

items.prompt: You ___ wear a seat belt in the car. It's the law.

hints.en: It's the law: it is an obligation.
Which word shows obligation?

explanation.he: must מבטא חובה: You must wear a seat belt. mustn't פירושו אסור, ו־don't have to פירושו לא חייבים.
explanation.en: must shows obligation. mustn't means it is not allowed, and don't have to means it is not necessary.

items.audioText: You must wear a seat belt in the car. It's the law.

items.prompt: She can ___ three languages.

hints.en: What comes after can?

hints.he: אחרי מודל בא פועל בסיס, בלי to ובלי s.
hints.en: After a modal: base verb, no to, no -s.

explanation.he: אחרי can, must, should בא פועל בסיס: can speak. לא can to speak ולא can speaks.
explanation.en: After can, must, should, use the base verb: can speak. Not can to speak or can speaks.

items.audioText: She can speak three languages.

items.prompt: You ___ use your phone during the exam. It is not allowed.

feedback.he: don't have to פירושו לא חייבים. כאן זה אסור.
feedback.en: don't have to means not necessary. Here it is not allowed.

feedback.he: It is not allowed: צריך שלילה.
feedback.en: It is not allowed: you need a negative.

hints.he: It is not allowed: איך אומרים אסור?
hints.en: It is not allowed: how do we say forbidden?

explanation.he: mustn't או can't מבטאים איסור. You mustn't use your phone.
explanation.en: mustn't or can't show that something is not allowed.

items.audioText: You mustn't use your phone during the exam. It is not allowed.

items.prompt: Tomorrow is Saturday, so I ___ get up early. I can sleep late.

hints.he: I can sleep late: זה לא חובה לקום מוקדם.
hints.en: I can sleep late: getting up early is not necessary.
Not necessary is not the same as not allowed.

explanation.he: don't have to = לא חייבים. mustn't = אסור. בעברית 'לא צריך' יכול להטעות. כאן מותר לקום מוקדם, פשוט לא חובה.
explanation.en: don't have to = not necessary. mustn't = not allowed. Here you may get up early; you just don't need to.

items.audioText: Tomorrow is Saturday, so I don't have to get up early. I can sleep late.

items.prompt: You look tired. You ___ go to bed early tonight.

hints.en: This is advice for a tired person.
Which word gives positive advice?

explanation.he: should נותן עצה: You should go to bed early. shouldn't ו־mustn't הם הפוך ממה שצריך כאן.
explanation.en: should gives advice. shouldn't and mustn't mean the opposite of what is needed here.

items.audioText: You look tired. You should go to bed early tonight.

items.prompt: ___ I open the window? It's hot in here.

hints.en: The speaker is asking for permission.
Which question word asks for permission?

explanation.he: Can I ...? מבקש רשות. גם May I הוא אפשרות מנומסת.
explanation.en: Can I ...? asks for permission. May I is also a polite option.

items.audioText: Can I open the window? It's hot in here.

items.prompt: When I was five, I ___ ride a bike.

hints.en: When I was five: the past.
What is the past of can?

explanation.he: יכולת בעבר: could + פועל בסיס. When I was five, I could ride a bike.
explanation.en: Ability in the past: could + base verb.

items.audioText: When I was five, I could ride a bike.

items.prompt: I ___ to finish my project last night, so I went to bed at 2 a.m. (have)

feedback.he: ל־must אין צורת עבר. לחובה בעבר משתמשים ב־had to.
feedback.en: must has no past form. For past obligation, use had to.

feedback.he: last night: צריך עבר.
feedback.en: last night: you need the past.

hints.en: last night: an obligation in the past.

explanation.he: חובה בעבר: had to + פועל בסיס. I had to finish my project.
explanation.en: Past obligation: had to + base verb. I had to finish my project.

items.audioText: I had to finish my project last night, so I went to bed at 2 a.m.

items.prompt: I ___ come to your party next week because I'm visiting my grandparents.

hints.en: next week: the future.

hints.he: אי אפשר לשים שני מודלים ביחד (will + can).
hints.en: You cannot put two modals together (will + can).

explanation.he: ל־can אין צורת עתיד. בעתיד משתמשים ב־will be able to / won't be able to. בעברית 'לא אוכל', באנגלית won't be able to.
explanation.en: can has no future form. Use will be able to / won't be able to.

items.audioText: I won't be able to come to your party next week because I'm visiting my grandparents.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: You should to see a doctor.

hints.en: What comes after should?
Only the base verb.

explanation.he: should + פועל בסיס: You should see a doctor. בלי to, בלי ing ובלי s.
explanation.en: should + base verb: You should see a doctor. No to, no -ing, no -s.

items.audioText: You should see a doctor.

items.prompt: Students ___ wear a uniform in our school. It's a rule.

hints.en: Students is plural.

hints.he: have to או has to? ואחרי must יש to?
hints.en: have to or has to? And does must take to?

explanation.he: have to מבטא חובה. עם רבים: Students have to. אחרי must ו־should אין to.
explanation.en: have to shows obligation. With plural: Students have to. No to after must or should.

items.audioText: Students have to wear a uniform in our school. It's a rule.

items.prompt: "May I use your phone?" What is the speaker doing?

hints.en: may in a question with I.

hints.he: מה רוצים לקבל כששואלים May I?
hints.en: What do you want when you ask May I?

explanation.he: May I ...? היא דרך מנומסת לבקש רשות, כמו 'אפשר...?' בעברית.
explanation.en: May I ...? is a polite way to ask for permission.

items.audioText: May I use your phone?

items.prompt: You ___ bought me a present, but thank you so much!

hints.he: הוא כבר קנה מתנה. זה היה מיותר.
hints.en: He already bought a present. It was not necessary.

hints.he: עשית משהו שלא היה צורך בו: needn't + have + V3.
hints.en: You did something that was not needed: needn't + have + V3.

explanation.he: needn't have + V3: עשית משהו, אבל לא היה צורך. You needn't have bought me a present.
explanation.en: needn't have + V3: you did it, but it was not necessary.

items.audioText: You needn't have bought me a present, but thank you so much!

items.prompt: He's only two, but he ___ count to ten.

feedback.he: מודלים לא מקבלים s, גם לא עם he.
feedback.en: Modals never take -s, even with he.

feedback.he: אחרי can לא בא to.
feedback.en: No to after can.

hints.en: This is ability in the present.

explanation.he: יכולת בהווה: can + פועל בסיס. מודלים לא משתנים: I can, he can.
explanation.en: Ability now: can + base verb. Modals do not change: I can, he can.

items.audioText: He's only two, but he can count to ten.

items.prompt: She has been working all day. She ___ be exhausted.

hints.he: היא עבדה כל היום. מה המסקנה ההגיונית?
hints.en: She worked all day. What is the logical conclusion?

hints.he: כשאנחנו כמעט בטוחים שמשהו נכון: must.
hints.en: When we are almost sure something is true: must.

explanation.he: must להסקה = 'בטח'. She must be exhausted: אני כמעט בטוח/ה שהיא עייפה מאוד.
explanation.en: must for deduction = almost sure it is true.

items.audioText: She has been working all day. She must be exhausted.

items.prompt: That ___ be Tom at the door. He's in London this week.

hints.he: טום בלונדון. זה אפשרי שהוא בדלת?
hints.en: Tom is in London. Is it possible he is at the door?
When we are sure something is not true: can't.

explanation.he: can't להסקה = 'בטוח שלא'. mustn't פירושו אסור, ולא משמש להסקה.
explanation.en: can't for deduction = sure it is not true. mustn't means not allowed and is not used for deduction.

items.audioText: That can't be Tom at the door. He's in London this week.

items.prompt: The lights are off and nobody is answering. They ___ be at home. (it's impossible)

feedback.he: mustn't פירושו אסור. להסקה שלילית משתמשים ב־can't.
feedback.en: mustn't means not allowed. For a negative deduction, use can't.

feedback.he: האורות כבויים. ההפך: הם בטח לא בבית.
feedback.en: The lights are off. The opposite: they are surely not home.

hints.en: it's impossible: we are sure it is not true.

explanation.he: כשבטוחים שמשהו לא נכון משתמשים ב־can't + פועל בסיס: They can't be at home.
explanation.en: When we are sure something is not true: can't + base verb.

items.audioText: The lights are off and nobody is answering. They can't be at home.

items.prompt: I can't find my keys. I ___ have left them at school.

hints.he: אני לא בטוח/ה איפה המפתחות. זו אפשרות.
hints.en: I'm not sure where the keys are. It is a possibility.

hints.he: אפשרות בעבר: might / may / could + have + V3.
hints.en: Past possibility: might / may / could + have + V3.

explanation.he: might have + V3 = 'אולי' בעבר. I might have left them at school. can have לא משמש כך במשפט חיובי.
explanation.en: might have + V3 = maybe, in the past. can have is not used like this in a positive sentence.

items.audioText: I can't find my keys. I might have left them at school.

items.prompt: The ground is wet. It ___ rained last night.

hints.en: last night: a deduction about the past.
must + have + V3.

explanation.he: הסקה על העבר: must have + V3. The ground is wet, so it must have rained.
explanation.en: Deduction about the past: must have + V3.

items.audioText: The ground is wet. It must have rained last night.

items.prompt: She didn't answer my call. She ___ have been asleep. (maybe)

feedback.he: must הוא כמעט בטוח. הרמז אומר maybe.
feedback.en: must means almost sure. The clue says maybe.

feedback.he: ל'אולי' בעבר משתמשים ב־might / may / could have.
feedback.en: For maybe in the past, use might / may / could have.

hints.en: maybe: we are not sure.

explanation.he: אפשרות בעבר: might / may / could + have + V3. She might have been asleep.
explanation.en: Past possibility: might / may / could + have + V3.

items.audioText: She didn't answer my call. She might have been asleep.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: He can't have seen us. It was too dark.
He mustn't have seen us. It was too dark.
He can't saw us. It was too dark.
He can't has seen us. It was too dark.

hints.he: בטוחים שהוא לא ראה. זה בעבר.
hints.en: We are sure he did not see. It is in the past.
can't + have + V3.

explanation.he: הסקה שלילית על העבר: can't have + V3. mustn't לא משמש להסקה, ואחרי מודל לא בא פועל בעבר.
explanation.en: Negative past deduction: can't have + V3. mustn't is not for deduction, and no past verb after a modal.

items.audioText: He can't have seen us. It was too dark.

items.prompt: Dan ___ be rich. He drives a very expensive car.

hints.en: A very expensive car: what is the conclusion?
We are almost sure it is true.

explanation.he: must להסקה חיובית: Dan must be rich. יש לו מכונית יקרה, אז זו מסקנה הגיונית.
explanation.en: must for a positive deduction. He has an expensive car, so it is a logical conclusion.

items.audioText: Dan must be rich. He drives a very expensive car.

items.prompt: The girl ___ sits next to me is from Haifa.

hints.en: We are talking about a person.
For people: who.

explanation.he: who לאנשים, which לדברים. בעברית 'ש' מתאים לשניהם, ובאנגלית צריך לבחור.
explanation.en: who for people, which for things. Hebrew uses ש for both; English needs a choice.

items.audioText: The girl who sits next to me is from Haifa.

items.prompt: This is the phone ___ I bought last week.

hints.en: phone is a thing.
For things: which or that.

explanation.he: לדברים משתמשים ב־which או that. This is the phone which I bought.
explanation.en: For things, use which or that.

items.audioText: This is the phone which I bought last week.

items.prompt: That's the café ___ we first met.

hints.he: café הוא מקום, ו־we met הוא משפט שלם.
hints.en: café is a place, and we met is a full clause.

hints.he: למקום עם משפט שלם אחריו: where.
hints.en: For a place followed by a full clause: where.

explanation.he: where = 'שבו' או 'שם'. אחרי where בא משפט שלם (we first met). which צריך מילת יחס: the café in which we met.
explanation.en: where = in which. A full clause follows where. which would need a preposition: the café in which we met.

items.audioText: That's the café where we first met.

items.prompt: I have a friend ___ father is a pilot.

hints.en: The friend's father: possession.
Which word means 'whose'?

explanation.he: whose מבטא שייכות: a friend whose father = חבר שאבא שלו. who's זה who is.
explanation.en: whose shows possession. who's means who is.

items.audioText: I have a friend whose father is a pilot.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: The movie that we watched was boring.
The movie that we watched it was boring.
The movie who we watched was boring.
The movie what we watched was boring.

hints.en: In Hebrew we say 'that we watched it'. In English?
that already replaces it.

explanation.he: ב־relative clause לא חוזרים על המילה: The movie that we watched. בלי it. וגם לא who לדברים או what.
explanation.en: In a relative clause, do not repeat the noun: The movie that we watched. No it.

items.audioText: The movie that we watched was boring.

items.prompt: The man ___ lives next door is a doctor.

feedback.he: which לדברים. man הוא בן אדם.
feedback.en: which is for things. man is a person.

feedback.he: where למקומות. כאן מדברים על בן אדם.
feedback.en: where is for places. Here it is a person.

hints.en: man: a person.

explanation.he: לאנשים: who (או that). The man who lives next door.
explanation.en: For people: who (or that).

items.audioText: The man who lives next door is a doctor.

items.prompt: Tel Aviv is the city ___ I was born.

instruction.he: להשלים את החסר (מילה אחת או שתיים)
instruction.en: Fill in the gap (one or two words)

feedback.he: which בלי מילת יחס לא מתאים. צריך where או in which.
feedback.en: which alone does not work here. Use where or in which.

feedback.he: the city that I was born חסר מילת יחס. צריך where.
feedback.en: the city that I was born is missing a preposition. Use where.

hints.en: city is a place.

explanation.he: למקום משתמשים ב־where: the city where I was born.
explanation.en: For a place: the city where I was born.

items.audioText: Tel Aviv is the city where I was born.

items.prompt: My brother, ___ lives in Eilat, is a diving teacher.

hints.en: There are commas. This is extra information.
After a comma, do not use that.

explanation.he: כשיש פסיקים (non-defining clause) משתמשים ב־who או which, אף פעם לא ב־that.
explanation.en: With commas (non-defining clause), use who or which, never that.

items.audioText: My brother, who lives in Eilat, is a diving teacher.

items.prompt: The students ___ projects won the prize were invited to the ceremony.

hints.en: Whose projects?
Possession: whose + noun.

explanation.he: whose + שם עצם: the students whose projects won = התלמידים שהפרויקטים שלהם זכו.
explanation.en: whose + noun shows possession.

items.audioText: The students whose projects won the prize were invited to the ceremony.

items.prompt: Do you know the boy ___ I met at the party?

hints.en: boy: a person.
which is only for things.

explanation.he: לאנשים: who או that. the boy who I met.
explanation.en: For people: who or that.

items.audioText: Do you know the boy who I met at the party?

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: This is the book I told you about.
This is the book I told you about it.
This is the book what I told you about.
This is the book about I told you.

hints.he: אפשר לוותר על that, אבל לא חוזרים על it.
hints.en: You can leave out that, but do not repeat it.
The preposition about stays at the end.

explanation.he: This is the book (that) I told you about. לא מוסיפים it, כי that (גם כשהוא לא כתוב) כבר מחליף אותו.
explanation.en: This is the book (that) I told you about. No it, because that already replaces it.

items.audioText: This is the book I told you about.

items.prompt: We visited Masada, ___ is near the Dead Sea.

hints.en: A comma before the gap: extra information.

hints.he: is בא מיד אחרי הרווח, אז צריך נושא.
hints.en: is comes right after the gap, so you need a subject.

explanation.he: אחרי פסיק משתמשים ב־which לדברים ומקומות. where לא יכול להיות נושא של is.
explanation.en: After a comma, use which for things and places. where cannot be the subject of is.

items.audioText: We visited Masada, which is near the Dead Sea.

items.prompt: The girl ___ bag was stolen called the police.

feedback.he: who's זה who is. לשייכות כותבים whose.
feedback.en: who's means who is. For possession, write whose.

feedback.he: התיק של הנערה: צריך מילה של שייכות.
feedback.en: The girl's bag: you need a possessive word.

hints.en: Whose bag was stolen?

explanation.he: whose + שם עצם מבטא שייכות: the girl whose bag was stolen.
explanation.en: whose + noun shows possession.

items.audioText: The girl whose bag was stolen called the police.

items.prompt: I enjoy ___ basketball with my friends.

hints.en: enjoy is a special verb.

hints.he: אחרי enjoy בא פועל עם ing.
hints.en: After enjoy, use -ing.

explanation.he: אחרי enjoy, finish, mind, avoid בא פועל עם ing: I enjoy playing.
explanation.en: After enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, use -ing: I enjoy playing.

items.audioText: I enjoy playing basketball with my friends.

items.prompt: We decided ___ a pizza.

hints.en: decide goes with to.

hints.he: decide, want, hope, plan + to + פועל.
hints.en: decide, want, hope, plan + to + verb.

explanation.he: אחרי decide בא to + פועל בסיס: We decided to order a pizza.
explanation.en: After decide, use to + base verb.

items.audioText: We decided to order a pizza.

items.prompt: She is interested in ___ photography. (learn)

feedback.he: אחרי מילת יחס (in) בא פועל עם ing, לא to.
feedback.en: After a preposition (in), use -ing, not to.

feedback.he: אחרי in הפועל צריך ing.
feedback.en: After in, the verb needs -ing.

hints.en: Which word comes before the gap?
in is a preposition.

explanation.he: אחרי מילת יחס (in, at, of, about, before, after) הפועל מקבל ing: interested in learning.
explanation.en: After a preposition, the verb takes -ing: interested in learning.

items.audioText: She is interested in learning photography.

items.prompt: He promised ___ late again.

hints.en: promise goes with to.
Where does not go? Before to.

explanation.he: promise + to + פועל. בשלילה: promise not to + פועל. He promised not to be late.
explanation.en: promise + to + verb. Negative: promise not to + verb.

items.audioText: He promised not to be late again.

items.prompt: I'm looking forward to ___ you next week.

hints.he: to כאן היא מילת יחס, לא חלק מ־to + פועל.
hints.en: Here to is a preposition, not part of an infinitive.
After a preposition: -ing.

explanation.he: look forward to + ing. ה־to הזה הוא מילת יחס, ולכן seeing. אותו דבר: used to (= רגיל ל־) + ing.
explanation.en: look forward to + -ing. This to is a preposition, so seeing.

items.audioText: I'm looking forward to seeing you next week.

items.prompt: Would you mind ___ the door?

hints.en: mind goes with -ing.

hints.he: Would you mind ...? היא בקשה מנומסת.
hints.en: Would you mind ...? is a polite request.

explanation.he: Would you mind + ing: Would you mind closing the door? (= אכפת לך לסגור?)
explanation.en: Would you mind + -ing: a polite request.

items.audioText: Would you mind closing the door?

items.prompt: ___ vegetables is good for your health.

hints.en: The gap is the subject of the sentence.
A verb used as a subject takes -ing.

explanation.he: כשפועל משמש כנושא בתחילת משפט משתמשים ב־ing: Eating vegetables is good.
explanation.en: When a verb is the subject, use -ing: Eating vegetables is good.

items.audioText: Eating vegetables is good for your health.

items.prompt: My parents want me ___ harder. (study)

instruction.he: להשלים את החסר (מילה אחת או שתיים)
instruction.en: Fill in the gap (one or two words)

feedback.he: want הולך עם to + פועל.
feedback.en: want goes with to + verb.

feedback.he: חסר to.
feedback.en: to is missing.

hints.en: want + someone + ?

explanation.he: want + אדם + to + פועל: My parents want me to study. בעברית 'רוצים שאלמד', באנגלית לא משתמשים ב־that.
explanation.en: want + person + to + verb. Hebrew uses 'that I study'; English uses to.

items.audioText: My parents want me to study harder.

items.prompt: Please remember ___ the lights when you leave.

hints.en: This is something to do in the future.
remember + to = don't forget to do.

explanation.he: remember to = לזכור לעשות משהו (בעתיד). remember + ing = לזכור משהו שכבר קרה.
explanation.en: remember to = remember to do something later. remember + -ing = remember something that happened.

items.audioText: Please remember to turn off the lights when you leave.

items.prompt: I'll never forget ___ the Eiffel Tower for the first time.

hints.en: It is a memory of something that already happened.
forget + -ing = forget a past experience.

explanation.he: forget + ing מדבר על זיכרון מהעבר: I'll never forget seeing it. forget to = לשכוח לעשות משהו.
explanation.en: forget + -ing is about a past memory. forget to = forget to do something.

items.audioText: I'll never forget seeing the Eiffel Tower for the first time.

items.prompt: She avoided ___ the question.

hints.en: avoid goes with -ing.
Like enjoy and mind.

explanation.he: avoid + ing: She avoided answering.
explanation.en: avoid + -ing: She avoided answering.

items.audioText: She avoided answering the question.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

hints.he: איזו מילת יחס באה אחרי good?
hints.en: Which preposition comes after good?

hints.he: ואחרי מילת יחס, איזו צורה של פועל?
hints.en: And after a preposition, which verb form?

explanation.he: good at + ing: I'm good at drawing. בעברית 'טוב ב־', באנגלית at.
explanation.en: good at + -ing. Hebrew says 'good in'; English says good at.

items.audioText: I'm good at drawing.

items.prompt: Instead of ___ the bus, we walked home. (take)

feedback.he: of היא מילת יחס, ואחריה בא ing.
feedback.en: of is a preposition, and -ing comes after it.

feedback.he: אחרי instead of צריך ing.
feedback.en: After instead of, you need -ing.

hints.en: instead of ends with a preposition.

explanation.he: instead of + ing: Instead of taking the bus.
explanation.en: instead of + -ing.

items.audioText: Instead of taking the bus, we walked home.

items.prompt: The teacher let us ___ early.

hints.en: let and make are special.
let + person + base verb.

explanation.he: let ו־make באים עם פועל בסיס בלי to: The teacher let us leave. She made me laugh.
explanation.en: let and make take the base verb without to.

items.audioText: The teacher let us leave early.

items.prompt: I can't afford ___ a new phone. (buy)

instruction.he: להשלים את החסר (מילה אחת או שתיים)
instruction.en: Fill in the gap (one or two words)

feedback.he: afford הולך עם to + פועל.
feedback.en: afford goes with to + verb.

feedback.he: חסר to.
feedback.en: to is missing.

hints.en: afford is like decide and want.

explanation.he: afford + to + פועל: I can't afford to buy = אין לי מספיק כסף לקנות.
explanation.en: afford + to + verb.

items.audioText: I can't afford to buy a new phone.

items.prompt: "I am hungry," Noa said yesterday. → Noa said that she ___ hungry.

hints.he: ב־reported speech הזמן זז צעד אחורה.
hints.en: In reported speech, the tense moves one step back.
am becomes ...?

explanation.he: am → was. בדיבור עקיף מזיזים את הזמן אחורה ומחליפים I ל־she: Noa said that she was hungry.
explanation.en: am → was. In reported speech, move the tense back and change I to she.

items.audioText: Noa said that she was hungry.

items.prompt: "I will call you tomorrow," Dan said last week. → Dan said he ___ call me the next day.

hints.en: will moves back.
will → ?

explanation.he: will → would. גם tomorrow הופך ל־the next day: Dan said he would call me the next day.
explanation.en: will → would, and tomorrow becomes the next day.

items.audioText: Dan said he would call me the next day.

items.prompt: He ___ me that he was busy.

hints.en: me comes after the gap.

hints.he: איזה פועל בא ישר עם אדם: say או tell?
hints.en: Which verb takes a person directly: say or tell?

explanation.he: tell + אדם: He told me. say בלי אדם: He said that... בעברית 'אמר לי', אבל באנגלית לא אומרים said me.
explanation.en: tell + person: He told me. say without a person: He said that... Not said me.

items.audioText: He told me that he was busy.

items.prompt: She ___ that the test was easy.

hints.en: There is no person after the gap.
tell needs a person after it.

explanation.he: say + that: She said that the test was easy. tell חייב אדם: She told me that...
explanation.en: say + that. tell must have a person: She told me that...

items.audioText: She said that the test was easy.

items.prompt: "We are playing football," they said. → They said they ___ playing football.

feedback.he: בדיבור עקיף הזמן זז אחורה: are → were.
feedback.en: In reported speech, move the tense back: are → were.

feedback.he: they הולך עם were.
feedback.en: they goes with were.

hints.en: The past of are is ...?

explanation.he: are → were. They said they were playing football.
explanation.en: are → were.

items.audioText: They said they were playing football.

items.prompt: "Where do you live?" she asked. → She asked me where I ___.

hints.he: זו כבר לא שאלה, אלא משפט רגיל.
hints.en: It is no longer a question, but a normal sentence.

hints.he: סדר רגיל: נושא + פועל, בלי do/did.
hints.en: Normal order: subject + verb, no do/did.

explanation.he: בשאלה מדווחת הסדר הוא כמו במשפט רגיל: where I lived. לא מוסיפים do או did.
explanation.en: In a reported question, use normal word order: where I lived. No do or did.

items.audioText: She asked me where I lived.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: He asked me what time it was.
He asked me what time was it.
He asked me what time is it.
He asked me what time did it be.

hints.he: שאלה מדווחת היא לא שאלה ישירה.
hints.en: A reported question is not a direct question.
Subject before verb: it was.

explanation.he: בשאלה מדווחת: מילת שאלה + נושא + פועל. He asked me what time it was.
explanation.en: Reported question: question word + subject + verb.

items.audioText: He asked me what time it was.

items.prompt: "Did you finish your homework?" Mom asked. → Mom asked ___ I had finished my homework.

hints.en: It is a yes/no question.

hints.he: איזו מילה מחברת שאלת כן/לא מדווחת?
hints.en: Which word introduces a reported yes/no question?

explanation.he: שאלת כן/לא מדווחים עם if או whether: Mom asked if I had finished.
explanation.en: Report a yes/no question with if or whether.

items.audioText: Mom asked if I had finished my homework.

items.prompt: "I have lost my keys," said Ben. → Ben said he ___ his keys.

instruction.he: להשלים את החסר (מילה אחת או שתיים)
instruction.en: Fill in the gap (one or two words)

feedback.he: בדיבור עקיף has lost זז אחורה ל־had lost.
feedback.en: In reported speech, has lost moves back to had lost.

feedback.he: כמעט. צריך עוד צעד אחורה: had + V3.
feedback.en: Almost. Move one more step back: had + V3.

hints.he: have lost (Present Perfect) זז אחורה ל...?
hints.en: have lost (Present Perfect) moves back to ...?

explanation.he: Present Perfect → Past Perfect: have lost → had lost.
explanation.en: Present Perfect → Past Perfect: have lost → had lost.

items.audioText: Ben said he had lost his keys.

items.prompt: "Don't touch the screen," the teacher said. → The teacher told us ___ the screen.

hints.en: It is an instruction (command).
tell + person + (not) to + verb.

explanation.he: ציווי מדווחים עם told + אדם + to. בשלילה: told us not to touch.
explanation.en: Report a command with told + person + to. Negative: told us not to touch.

items.audioText: The teacher told us not to touch the screen.

items.prompt: You're from Jerusalem, ___?

hints.en: The sentence is positive, so the tag is negative.
The verb in the sentence is are.

explanation.he: משפט חיובי, tag שלילי, עם אותו פועל עזר: You're ..., aren't you? בעברית אומרים 'נכון?' לכל משפט, ובאנגלית ה־tag משתנה.
explanation.en: Positive sentence, negative tag, same auxiliary. Hebrew uses 'נכון?' for all; English changes the tag.

items.audioText: You're from Jerusalem, aren't you?

items.prompt: She doesn't eat meat, ___?

hints.en: The sentence is negative.
The auxiliary is does.

explanation.he: משפט שלילי, tag חיובי: She doesn't ..., does she?
explanation.en: Negative sentence, positive tag.

items.audioText: She doesn't eat meat, does she?

items.prompt: They went to the beach, ___?

hints.he: went הוא עבר פשוט בלי פועל עזר.
hints.en: went is Past Simple with no auxiliary.

hints.he: בעבר פשוט פועל העזר הוא did.
hints.en: In the Past Simple, the auxiliary is did.

explanation.he: כשאין פועל עזר משתמשים ב־do / does / did. went → didn't they?
explanation.en: With no auxiliary, use do / does / did. went → didn't they?

items.audioText: They went to the beach, didn't they?

items.prompt: He can drive, ___ he?

feedback.he: המשפט חיובי, אז ה־tag צריך להיות שלילי.
feedback.en: The sentence is positive, so the tag must be negative.

feedback.he: יש פועל עזר במשפט: can. משתמשים בו.
feedback.en: There is an auxiliary in the sentence: can. Use it.

hints.en: Which auxiliary is in the sentence?

explanation.he: He can drive, can't he? משפט חיובי עם can, tag שלילי עם can.
explanation.en: Positive with can, negative tag with can.

items.audioText: He can drive, can't he?

items.prompt: Let's order pizza, ___?

hints.en: Let's is a suggestion.
Let's has a fixed tag.

explanation.he: אחרי Let's ה־tag הוא תמיד shall we? Let's go, shall we?
explanation.en: After Let's, the tag is always shall we?

items.audioText: Let's order pizza, shall we?

items.prompt: I'm late, ___?

hints.en: This is an exception.
I am has a special tag.

explanation.he: ה־tag של I am הוא aren't I? (לא amn't I). I'm late, aren't I?
explanation.en: The tag for I am is aren't I?

items.audioText: I'm late, aren't I?

items.prompt: You haven't seen my phone, ___ you?

feedback.he: המשפט שלילי, אז ה־tag חיובי.
feedback.en: The sentence is negative, so the tag is positive.

feedback.he: פועל העזר במשפט הוא have.
feedback.en: The auxiliary in the sentence is have.

hints.he: המשפט שלילי. איזה פועל עזר יש בו?
hints.en: The sentence is negative. Which auxiliary does it have?

explanation.he: משפט שלילי עם haven't, tag חיובי עם have: haven't ..., have you?
explanation.en: Negative with haven't, positive tag with have.

items.audioText: You haven't seen my phone, have you?

items.prompt: Nobody called, ___?

hints.en: nobody is a negative word.

hints.he: אחרי nobody ה־tag חיובי, והנושא בו הוא they.
hints.en: After nobody, the tag is positive, with they.

explanation.he: nobody הופך את המשפט לשלילי, לכן ה־tag חיובי: did they? משתמשים ב־they עבור nobody ו־somebody.
explanation.en: nobody makes the sentence negative, so the tag is positive. Use they for nobody and somebody.

items.audioText: Nobody called, did they?

items.prompt: My father is ___ engineer.

hints.he: באנגלית עם מקצוע צריך a או an.
hints.en: In English, a job needs a or an.
engineer starts with a vowel sound.

explanation.he: בעברית 'אבא שלי מהנדס'. באנגלית חובה a/an לפני מקצוע. לפני צליל תנועה: an engineer.
explanation.en: Hebrew has no a. In English a job needs a/an. Before a vowel sound: an engineer.

items.audioText: My father is an engineer.

items.prompt: She wants to be ___ doctor.

hints.en: A job in the singular needs a word before it.
doctor starts with a consonant.

explanation.he: לפני מקצוע ביחיד שמים a או an. doctor מתחיל בעיצור: a doctor.
explanation.en: Put a or an before a singular job. doctor starts with a consonant: a doctor.

items.audioText: She wants to be a doctor.

items.prompt: I think ___ life is beautiful.

hints.en: We are talking about life in general.

hints.he: שמות עצם כלליים ומופשטים לא מקבלים the.
hints.en: General, abstract nouns don't take the.

explanation.he: בעברית 'החיים יפים', עם ה'. באנגלית על דבר כללי לא שמים the: Life is beautiful.
explanation.en: Hebrew says 'the life'. In English, general ideas take no article: Life is beautiful.

items.audioText: I think life is beautiful.

items.prompt: I need ___ information about the trip.

hints.he: information הוא שם עצם שלא סופרים.
hints.en: information is uncountable.

hints.he: אי אפשר a / an עם דבר שלא סופרים.
hints.en: You can't use a / an with uncountable nouns.

explanation.he: information לא נספר: אין an information ואין informations. אומרים some information או a piece of information.
explanation.en: information is uncountable: not an information. Say some information or a piece of information.

items.audioText: I need some information about the trip.

items.prompt: Can you give me ___ advice?

hints.en: advice is uncountable in English.

hints.he: איזו מילה מתאימה לדבר שלא סופרים?
hints.en: Which word fits an uncountable noun?

explanation.he: בעברית 'עצה' נספרת, אבל באנגלית advice לא נספר: some advice, a piece of advice. לא an advice.
explanation.en: In Hebrew עצה is countable, but advice is uncountable in English: some advice, not an advice.

items.audioText: Can you give me some advice?

items.prompt: I saw a dog in the park. ___ dog was very big.

hints.en: We already mentioned this dog.
Second time: the.

explanation.he: בפעם הראשונה: a dog. בפעם השנייה, כשכבר יודעים על איזה כלב מדובר: the dog.
explanation.en: First time: a dog. Second time, when we know which dog: the dog.

items.audioText: I saw a dog in the park. The dog was very big.

items.prompt: ___ moon goes around the Earth.

hints.he: יש רק ירח אחד לכדור הארץ.
hints.en: Earth has only one moon.
For something unique: the.

explanation.he: דבר שיש רק אחד כמוהו מקבל the: the moon, the sun, the sky.
explanation.en: Something unique takes the: the moon, the sun, the sky.

items.audioText: The moon goes around the Earth.

items.prompt: We usually go to school by ___ bus.

hints.en: by + type of transport.
It is a fixed phrase.

explanation.he: by bus, by car, by train: בלי a ובלי the.
explanation.en: by bus, by car, by train: no article.

items.audioText: We usually go to school by bus.

items.prompt: I love ___ music, especially jazz.

hints.he: מוזיקה באופן כללי, לא מוזיקה מסוימת.
hints.en: Music in general, not specific music.
General = no the.

explanation.he: בעברית 'אני אוהב/ת את המוזיקה'. באנגלית על דבר כללי: I love music, בלי the.
explanation.en: In English, general nouns take no article: I love music.

items.audioText: I love music, especially jazz.

items.prompt: She is ___ honest person. (a / an)

feedback.he: honest מתחיל בצליל תנועה, כי ה־h לא נשמעת.
feedback.en: honest starts with a vowel sound because the h is silent.

hints.en: How do you say honest? Do you hear the h?

explanation.he: בוחרים a או an לפי הצליל, לא לפי האות. ב־honest ה־h שקטה: an honest person.
explanation.en: Choose a or an by sound, not by letter. The h in honest is silent: an honest person.

items.audioText: She is an honest person.

items.prompt: He is ___ university student. (a / an)

feedback.he: university מתחיל בצליל 'יו', שהוא עיצור. לכן a.
feedback.en: university starts with a 'you' sound, a consonant. So a.

hints.he: איך מבטאים את ההתחלה של university?
hints.en: How does university begin when you say it?

explanation.he: הצליל קובע: university נשמע 'יוניברסיטי', ולכן a university.
explanation.en: The sound decides: university starts with a 'y' sound, so a university.

items.audioText: He is a university student.

items.prompt: ___ Israel is a small country.

hints.en: Israel is a country name.
Most country names take no the.

explanation.he: שמות של מדינות, ערים ואנשים בדרך כלל בלי the: Israel, France, Haifa. יוצאי דופן: the USA, the UK.
explanation.en: Names of countries, cities and people usually take no the. Exceptions: the USA, the UK.

items.audioText: Israel is a small country.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: She plays the piano and he plays football.
She plays the piano and he plays the football.
She plays a piano and he plays a football.

hints.en: Musical instruments and sports behave differently.
Sports take no the.

explanation.he: play the piano (כלי נגינה עם the), play football (ספורט בלי the).
explanation.en: play the piano (instruments with the), play football (sports with no article).

items.audioText: She plays the piano and he plays football.

items.prompt: In my opinion, ___ rich should pay more taxes.

hints.he: rich הוא שם תואר. כאן הוא מתאר קבוצה של אנשים.
hints.en: rich is an adjective. Here it means a group of people.
the + adjective = all people who are ...

explanation.he: the + שם תואר מתאר קבוצה: the rich (העשירים), the poor, the young. בלי the זה לא נכון.
explanation.en: the + adjective = a group: the rich, the poor, the young.

items.audioText: In my opinion, the rich should pay more taxes.

items.prompt: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.

feedback.he: יש רק הר אחד שהוא הגבוה ביותר. לכן the.
feedback.en: Only one mountain is the highest. So the.

hints.en: highest is a superlative.

explanation.he: לפני סופרלטיב תמיד the: the highest, the best, the most interesting.
explanation.en: Superlatives always take the: the highest, the best.

items.audioText: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

hints.en: A singular job.

hints.he: צריך גם פועל וגם a / an.
hints.en: You need both a verb and a / an.

explanation.he: He is a teacher. באנגלית צריך גם is וגם a. teacher מתחיל בעיצור, ולכן a.
explanation.en: He is a teacher. English needs both is and a.

items.audioText: He is a teacher.

items.prompt: My birthday is ___ May.

hints.en: May is a month.
Months, years and seasons: in.

explanation.he: in לחודשים, שנים ועונות: in May, in 2015, in summer.
explanation.en: in for months, years and seasons.

items.audioText: My birthday is in May.

items.prompt: The lesson starts ___ 8 o'clock.

hints.en: 8 o'clock is a time on the clock.
For clock times: at.

explanation.he: at לשעה מדויקת: at 8 o'clock, at noon, at midnight.
explanation.en: at for clock times.

items.audioText: The lesson starts at 8 o'clock.

items.prompt: We have a test ___ Monday.

hints.en: Monday is a day.
Days and dates: on.

explanation.he: on לימים ולתאריכים: on Monday, on 5 June, on my birthday.
explanation.en: on for days and dates.

items.audioText: We have a test on Monday.

items.prompt: I was born ___ 2010.

feedback.he: on לימים ותאריכים. לשנה: in.
feedback.en: on is for days and dates. For a year: in.

feedback.he: at לשעות. לשנה: in.
feedback.en: at is for clock times. For a year: in.

hints.en: 2010 is a year.

explanation.he: in לשנים: in 2010. אבל on לתאריך מלא: on 3 March 2010.
explanation.en: in for years. But on for a full date: on 3 March 2010.

items.audioText: I was born in 2010.

items.prompt: The keys are ___ the table.

hints.he: המפתחות נמצאים על המשטח של השולחן.
hints.en: The keys are on the surface of the table.
On a surface: on.

explanation.he: on = על משטח: on the table, on the wall, on the floor.
explanation.en: on = on a surface.

items.audioText: The keys are on the table.

items.prompt: She lives ___ Ashdod.

hints.en: Ashdod is a city.
Cities and countries: in.

explanation.he: in לעיר או מדינה: in Ashdod, in Israel.
explanation.en: in for cities and countries.

items.audioText: She lives in Ashdod.

items.prompt: Let's meet ___ the bus stop.

hints.en: A bus stop is a specific point.
For a meeting point: at.

explanation.he: at לנקודה או מקום מסוים: at the bus stop, at the door, at school.
explanation.en: at for a point or specific place.

items.audioText: Let's meet at the bus stop.

items.prompt: Are you interested ___ science?

hints.he: interested הולך עם מילת יחס קבועה.
hints.en: interested has a fixed preposition.
interested ___ = מתעניין ב...

explanation.he: interested in. מילות יחס אחרי שמות תואר צריך ללמוד כצמד: interested in, good at, afraid of.
explanation.en: interested in. Learn adjectives with their prepositions as pairs.

items.audioText: Are you interested in science?

items.prompt: Shira is very good ___ math.

hints.en: In Hebrew 'good in'. In English?
good + at.

explanation.he: good at, bad at. בעברית 'טוב ב', אבל באנגלית אומרים good at math.
explanation.en: good at, bad at. Hebrew uses ב, but English says good at.

items.audioText: Shira is very good at math.

items.prompt: It depends ___ the weather.

feedback.he: בעברית 'תלוי ב', אבל באנגלית depend on.
feedback.en: Hebrew says 'depends in', but English says depend on.

feedback.he: depend הולך עם on.
feedback.en: depend goes with on.

hints.en: depend ___ = תלוי ב...

explanation.he: depend on: It depends on the weather. כדאי לזכור כצמד.
explanation.en: depend on: learn it as a pair.

items.audioText: It depends on the weather.

items.prompt: I'm afraid ___ spiders.

hints.en: In Hebrew 'afraid from'.
afraid + of.

explanation.he: afraid of. בעברית 'מ', ולכן הרבה אומרים from, אבל באנגלית afraid of spiders.
explanation.en: afraid of. Hebrew uses מ, so learners say from, but English says afraid of.

items.audioText: I'm afraid of spiders.

items.prompt: We arrived ___ the airport at six.

hints.en: arrive does not go with to.

hints.he: arrive at למקום מסוים, arrive in לעיר או מדינה.
hints.en: arrive at a place, arrive in a city or country.

explanation.he: arrive at the airport, arrive in London. לא arrive to, למרות ש־go to.
explanation.en: arrive at the airport, arrive in London. Never arrive to, even though we say go to.

items.audioText: We arrived at the airport at six.

items.prompt: She is married ___ a doctor.

hints.en: married + a fixed preposition.
In Hebrew 'married to'.

explanation.he: married to: She is married to a doctor. לא married with.
explanation.en: married to, not married with.

items.audioText: She is married to a doctor.

items.prompt: Thank you ___ your help.

feedback.he: בעברית 'תודה על', אבל באנגלית thank you for.
feedback.en: Hebrew says 'thanks on', but English says thank you for.

feedback.he: thank you הולך עם for.
feedback.en: thank you goes with for.

hints.en: תודה על... = thank you ___

explanation.he: thank you for + שם עצם או ing: Thank you for your help. Thank you for coming.
explanation.en: thank you for + noun or -ing.

items.audioText: Thank you for your help.

items.prompt: He apologized ___ being late.

hints.en: To apologize for something.
apologize + for.

explanation.he: apologize for + ing: He apologized for being late. בעברית 'על', באנגלית for.
explanation.en: apologize for + -ing.

items.audioText: He apologized for being late.

items.prompt: Who is responsible ___ this project?

hints.en: In Hebrew 'responsible on'.
responsible + for.

explanation.he: responsible for. בעברית 'אחראי על', ולכן קל לטעות ב־on.
explanation.en: responsible for. Hebrew uses על, so learners say on.

items.audioText: Who is responsible for this project?

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

hints.he: listen צריך מילת יחס לפני מה ששומעים.
hints.en: listen needs a preposition before what you hear.
listen + to.

explanation.he: listen to: I'm listening to music. בעברית 'מקשיב/ה למוזיקה', וה־ל הופכת ל־to.
explanation.en: listen to: I'm listening to music.

items.audioText: I'm listening to music.

items.prompt: We met ___ the morning.

hints.en: Parts of the day.

hints.he: in the morning, in the afternoon, but at night.
hints.en: in the morning, in the afternoon, but at night.

explanation.he: in the morning / afternoon / evening. יוצא דופן: at night.
explanation.en: in the morning / afternoon / evening. Exception: at night.

items.audioText: We met in the morning.

items.prompt: I'm waiting ___ the bus.

hints.en: To wait for, in English?
wait + for.

explanation.he: wait for: I'm waiting for the bus. בעברית 'מחכה ל', אבל באנגלית for.
explanation.en: wait for. Hebrew uses ל, but English uses for.

items.audioText: I'm waiting for the bus.

items.prompt: How ___ brothers do you have?

hints.en: brothers: you can count them.
many for countable things.

explanation.he: How many + רבים נספרים: How many brothers? How much + דבר שלא סופרים: How much water?
explanation.en: How many + countable plural. How much + uncountable.

items.audioText: How many brothers do you have?

items.prompt: We don't have ___ time.

hints.en: time here is uncountable.

hints.he: מה הולך עם דבר שלא סופרים?
hints.en: What goes with uncountable nouns?

explanation.he: much עם דבר שלא סופרים, בעיקר בשלילה ובשאלה: We don't have much time.
explanation.en: much with uncountable nouns, especially in negatives and questions.

items.audioText: We don't have much time.

items.prompt: There are ___ apples in the fridge. Do you want one?

hints.en: The sentence is positive.

hints.he: some במשפט חיובי, any בשלילה ובשאלה.
hints.en: some in positive sentences, any in negatives and questions.

explanation.he: some במשפט חיובי: There are some apples. any בשלילה: There aren't any apples.
explanation.en: some in positive sentences, any in negatives.

items.audioText: There are some apples in the fridge. Do you want one?

items.prompt: There isn't ___ milk left.

hints.en: isn't: the sentence is negative.
milk is uncountable.

explanation.he: בשלילה משתמשים ב־any: There isn't any milk.
explanation.en: In negatives use any.

items.audioText: There isn't any milk left.

items.prompt: I have ___ friends in my new school, so I'm not lonely.

hints.he: friends נספרים. וגם: אני לא בודד/ה, אז יש כמה.
hints.en: friends are countable. Also: I'm not lonely, so I have some.

hints.he: a few = כמה (חיובי). few = מעט מדי (שלילי).
hints.en: a few = some (positive). few = not enough (negative).

explanation.he: a few + נספרים = כמה, וזה טוב. few לבד = כמעט אין, וזה לא מתאים ל־I'm not lonely. a little הולך עם דבר שלא סופרים.
explanation.en: a few + countable = some (positive). few alone = almost none. a little goes with uncountable nouns.

items.audioText: I have a few friends in my new school, so I'm not lonely.

items.prompt: There is very ___ sugar in my tea. It isn't sweet at all.

hints.en: sugar is uncountable.
very little = almost none.

explanation.he: little עם דבר שלא סופרים = מעט מאוד. very little sugar. few ו־a few הולכים עם דברים שסופרים.
explanation.en: little with uncountable = not much. few and a few go with countable nouns.

items.audioText: There is very little sugar in my tea. It isn't sweet at all.

items.prompt: How ___ money do you need?

feedback.he: money לא נספר באנגלית. אומרים How much money.
feedback.en: money is uncountable in English. Say How much money.

hints.en: Can you say 'three moneys'?

explanation.he: money לא נספר (סופרים shekels, לא money), ולכן How much money?
explanation.en: money is uncountable (we count shekels, not money), so How much money?

items.audioText: How much money do you need?

items.prompt: She has ___ books in her room.

hints.en: books are countable, and the sentence is positive.

hints.he: a lot צריך עוד מילה לפני שם עצם.
hints.en: a lot needs another word before a noun.

explanation.he: a lot of מתאים לכל סוג של שם עצם במשפט חיובי. לפני שם עצם צריך of: a lot of books.
explanation.en: a lot of works with all nouns in positive sentences. Before a noun, you need of.

items.audioText: She has a lot of books in her room.

items.prompt: ___ student in my class has a phone.

hints.en: The verb has is singular.

hints.he: איזו מילה באה עם שם עצם ביחיד?
hints.en: Which word goes with a singular noun?

explanation.he: every + שם עצם ביחיד + פועל ביחיד: Every student has. all, many, most באים עם רבים: All students have.
explanation.en: every + singular noun + singular verb. all, many, most take plurals.

items.audioText: Every student in my class has a phone.

items.prompt: There were very ___ people at the concert, so it was quiet.

hints.en: people are countable.
very few = almost none (countable).

explanation.he: few + נספרים = מעט. very few people. little הולך עם דבר שלא סופרים.
explanation.en: few + countable = not many. little goes with uncountable nouns.

items.audioText: There were very few people at the concert, so it was quiet.

items.prompt: I have ___ money than you.

hints.en: than: a comparison.
money is uncountable.

explanation.he: השוואה עם דבר שלא סופרים: less. עם נספרים: fewer (fewer books). least הוא סופרלטיב.
explanation.en: Compare uncountable nouns with less, countable with fewer. least is a superlative.

items.audioText: I have less money than you.

items.prompt: Would you like ___ tea? (some / any)

feedback.he: זו הצעה. בהצעות ובבקשות משתמשים ב־some גם בשאלה.
feedback.en: It is an offer. In offers and requests, use some even in questions.

hints.en: Would you like...? is an offer.

explanation.he: בשאלה רגילה any, אבל בהצעה או בקשה some: Would you like some tea?
explanation.en: In normal questions use any, but in offers and requests use some.

items.audioText: Would you like some tea?

items.prompt: My brother is ___ than me.

hints.en: tall is a short word.
Short word + -er.

explanation.he: שם תואר קצר: er + than. taller than. לא מוסיפים more למילה עם er.
explanation.en: Short adjective: -er + than. Never more with -er.

items.audioText: My brother is taller than me.

items.prompt: This test is ___ than the last one.

hints.en: easy ends in -y.
y changes to i, then add -er.

explanation.he: easy → easier. מילה בשתי הברות שמסתיימת ב־y מקבלת ier, בלי more.
explanation.en: easy → easier. Two-syllable adjectives ending in -y take -ier, without more.

items.audioText: This test is easier than the last one.

items.prompt: Eilat is hotter ___ Tel Aviv in summer.

hints.en: In Hebrew 'hotter from'. In English?
Comparison: than.

explanation.he: בהשוואה משתמשים ב־than: hotter than. בעברית 'מ', אבל לא from. וגם לא then (= אז).
explanation.en: Comparisons use than. Hebrew uses מ, but not from. And not then (= after that).

items.audioText: Eilat is hotter than Tel Aviv in summer.

items.prompt: Today is ___ than yesterday. (good)

feedback.he: good הוא חריג: good, better, best.
feedback.en: good is irregular: good, better, best.

feedback.he: better כבר השוואה. לא מוסיפים more.
feedback.en: better is already a comparative. Don't add more.

feedback.he: good הוא חריג: better.
feedback.en: good is irregular: better.

hints.en: good is an irregular adjective.

explanation.he: good → better → the best. Today is better than yesterday.
explanation.en: good → better → the best.

items.audioText: Today is better than yesterday.

items.prompt: This is the ___ movie I have ever seen.

hints.he: the + I have ever seen: סופרלטיב.
hints.en: the + I have ever seen: superlative.
good, better, ?

explanation.he: סופרלטיב של good הוא the best. the best movie I have ever seen.
explanation.en: The superlative of good is the best.

items.audioText: This is the best movie I have ever seen.

items.prompt: Math is ___ subject for me.

hints.en: difficult is a long word.

hints.he: סופרלטיב של מילה ארוכה: the most.
hints.en: Superlative of a long word: the most.

explanation.he: מילה ארוכה: the most + שם תואר. וחייבים the לפני סופרלטיב.
explanation.en: Long adjective: the most + adjective. A superlative needs the.

items.audioText: Math is the most difficult subject for me.

items.prompt: My bag is ___ than yours. (heavy)

feedback.he: y אחרי עיצור הופך ל־i: heavier.
feedback.en: y after a consonant changes to i: heavier.

feedback.he: heavy מסתיים ב־y, ולכן ier ולא more.
feedback.en: heavy ends in -y, so -ier, not more.

feedback.he: לא מוסיפים more למילה עם er.
feedback.en: Don't add more to an -er word.

hints.en: heavy ends in -y.

explanation.he: heavy → heavier, כמו easy → easier.
explanation.en: heavy → heavier, like easy → easier.

items.audioText: My bag is heavier than yours.

items.prompt: The weather today is ___ than yesterday. (bad)

hints.en: bad is irregular.

hints.he: bad, worse, worst. מה מתאים עם than?
hints.en: bad, worse, worst. Which fits with than?

explanation.he: bad → worse → the worst. עם than משתמשים בהשוואה: worse than.
explanation.en: bad → worse → the worst. With than, use the comparative: worse than.

items.audioText: The weather today is worse than yesterday.

items.prompt: She is as tall ___ her mother.

hints.en: as ... ___ = the same.
The structure repeats the same word.

explanation.he: as + שם תואר + as = באותה מידה: as tall as. לא as tall than.
explanation.en: as + adjective + as = equal: as tall as.

items.audioText: She is as tall as her mother.

items.prompt: The ___ you practise, the better you get.

hints.en: the + comparative, the + comparative.

hints.he: better היא השוואה. מה מתאים בחלק הראשון?
hints.en: better is a comparative. What fits in the first part?

explanation.he: The more ..., the better ... = ככל ש... כך... שני החלקים בהשוואה.
explanation.en: The more ..., the better ...: both parts use a comparative.

items.audioText: The more you practise, the better you get.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: This phone is much cheaper than that one.
This phone is very cheaper than that one.
This phone is more cheaper than that one.
This phone is much cheaper from that one.

hints.he: איך מחזקים השוואה? very או much?
hints.en: How do you make a comparative stronger: very or much?
much / a lot / far + comparative.

explanation.he: לפני השוואה משתמשים ב־much, a lot או far: much cheaper than. לא very cheaper.
explanation.en: Before a comparative, use much, a lot or far, not very.

items.audioText: This phone is much cheaper than that one.

items.prompt: Of all my friends, Yoni is ___.

hints.he: Of all my friends: משווים לכולם.
hints.en: Of all my friends: compared to everyone.
funny → ?

explanation.he: כשמשווים לקבוצה: סופרלטיב. funny → the funniest (y הופך ל־i).
explanation.en: Compared with a group: superlative. funny → the funniest.

items.audioText: Of all my friends, Yoni is the funniest.

items.prompt: The cat is licking ___ paw.

hints.en: The cat's paw: possession.
it's = it is.

explanation.he: its (בלי גרש) = שלו/שלה לדבר או חיה. it's (עם גרש) = it is.
explanation.en: its (no apostrophe) = belonging to it. it's = it is.

items.audioText: The cat is licking its paw.

items.prompt: ___ going to rain today.

hints.en: You need it is here.

hints.he: קיצור של it is כותבים עם גרש.
hints.en: The short form of it is has an apostrophe.

explanation.he: It's = It is. It's going to rain. Its בלי גרש הוא שייכות.
explanation.en: It's = It is. Its without an apostrophe shows possession.

items.audioText: It's going to rain today.

items.prompt: My friends left ___ bags in the classroom.

hints.en: The friends' bags: possession.
Three words sound the same.

explanation.he: their = שלהם. there = שם / יש. they're = they are.
explanation.en: their = belonging to them. there = in that place. they're = they are.

items.audioText: My friends left their bags in the classroom.

items.prompt: I hurt ___ while I was playing football.

feedback.he: כשהנושא והמושא הם אותו אדם: myself.
feedback.en: When the subject and object are the same person: myself.

feedback.he: כותבים במילה אחת: myself.
feedback.en: Write it as one word: myself.

hints.en: I hurt ... (the same person).

explanation.he: I hurt myself = נפגעתי (פגעתי בעצמי). myself, yourself, himself, herself, ourselves, themselves.
explanation.en: When you do something to yourself: myself, yourself, himself...

items.audioText: I hurt myself while I was playing football.

items.prompt: The boys made the cake by ___.

hints.en: by + reflexive = alone.
they → ?

explanation.he: they → themselves. theirselves לא קיים. by themselves = לבד, בלי עזרה.
explanation.en: they → themselves. theirselves does not exist.

items.audioText: The boys made the cake by themselves.

items.prompt: He taught ___ to play the guitar.

hints.en: He taught the same person: himself.
he → him + self.

explanation.he: he → himself. hisself לא קיים. He taught himself = הוא לימד את עצמו.
explanation.en: he → himself. hisself does not exist.

items.audioText: He taught himself to play the guitar.

items.prompt: Is this pen yours or ___?

hints.en: yours = belonging to you. What about me?
No noun comes after the word.

explanation.he: כשאין שם עצם אחרי: mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs. my בא רק לפני שם עצם: my pen.
explanation.en: With no noun after it: mine, yours, his. my comes only before a noun.

items.audioText: Is this pen yours or mine?

items.prompt: Dana and ___ went to the cinema.

hints.en: This is the subject of the sentence.

hints.he: לנסות בלי Dana: ___ went to the cinema.
hints.en: Try it without Dana: ___ went to the cinema.

explanation.he: בנושא משתמשים ב־I: Dana and I went. אם מורידים את Dana, ברור שאומרים I went ולא me went.
explanation.en: In the subject, use I: Dana and I went. Without Dana you say I went, not me went.

items.audioText: Dana and I went to the cinema.

items.prompt: ___ are many reasons to learn English. (there / their / they're)

feedback.he: their = שלהם. כאן צריך 'יש': There are.
feedback.en: their = belonging to them. Here you need There are.

feedback.he: They're = They are. אז זה They are are. צריך There.
feedback.en: They're = They are. You need There.

hints.he: יש הרבה סיבות = ___ are many reasons.
hints.en: יש הרבה סיבות = ___ are many reasons.

explanation.he: There are = יש. their = שלהם. they're = they are.
explanation.en: There are = there exist. their = belonging to them. they're = they are.

items.audioText: There are many reasons to learn English.

items.prompt: ___ a cat under the table.

hints.en: How do we say יש in English?
a cat is singular.

explanation.he: יש = there is (יחיד) / there are (רבים). בעברית 'יש', אבל באנגלית לא משתמשים ב־have או it has.
explanation.en: יש = there is (singular) / there are (plural). Not have or it has.

items.audioText: There is a cat under the table.

items.prompt: ___ many people at the beach today.

hints.en: many people: plural.
Plural: there are.

explanation.he: עם רבים: There are many people.
explanation.en: With plural nouns: There are.

items.audioText: There are many people at the beach today.

items.prompt: ___ there any eggs in the fridge?

feedback.he: eggs ברבים. צריך Are.
feedback.en: eggs is plural. Use Are.

feedback.he: בשאלה על 'יש' משתמשים ב־Is / Are there.
feedback.en: To ask about יש, use Is / Are there.

hints.en: eggs: singular or plural?

explanation.he: בשאלה מחליפים את הסדר: Are there any eggs? (רבים).
explanation.en: In questions, change the order: Are there any eggs?

items.audioText: Are there any eggs in the fridge?

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: There is a big park in my city.
In my city have a big park.
It has a big park in my city.
There are a big park in my city.

hints.en: How do we say יש in English?
a big park is singular.

explanation.he: There is a big park in my city. בעברית 'בעיר שלי יש', אבל באנגלית there is, לא have.
explanation.en: Hebrew uses יש; English uses there is, not have.

items.audioText: There is a big park in my city.

items.prompt: There ___ some water on the floor.

hints.en: water is uncountable.

hints.he: דבר שלא סופרים מתנהג כמו יחיד.
hints.en: Uncountable nouns act like singular.

explanation.he: דבר שלא סופרים (water, money, information) הולך עם there is.
explanation.en: Uncountable nouns take there is.

items.audioText: There is some water on the floor.

items.prompt: Three ___ are playing in the garden.

hints.en: child has an irregular plural.
child → ?

explanation.he: child → children. children כבר רבים, ולכן לא מוסיפים s.
explanation.en: child → children. It is already plural, so no -s.

items.audioText: Three children are playing in the garden.

items.prompt: One mouse, two ___.

feedback.he: mouse הוא חריג: mice.
feedback.en: mouse is irregular: mice.

hints.he: זו מילה חריגה, כמו tooth → teeth.
hints.en: It is irregular, like tooth → teeth.

explanation.he: mouse → mice. גם louse → lice.
explanation.en: mouse → mice.

items.audioText: One mouse, two mice.

items.prompt: I brushed my ___ before bed.

hints.en: tooth is irregular.
foot → feet, tooth → ?

explanation.he: tooth → teeth, foot → feet, goose → geese.
explanation.en: tooth → teeth, foot → feet.

items.audioText: I brushed my teeth before bed.

items.prompt: One woman, two ___.

feedback.he: woman הוא חריג: women.
feedback.en: woman is irregular: women.

feedback.he: women כבר רבים. לא מוסיפים s.
feedback.en: women is already plural. No -s.

hints.en: man → men. woman → ?

explanation.he: man → men, woman → women.
explanation.en: man → men, woman → women.

items.audioText: One woman, two women.

items.prompt: Can you send me the ___ about the course?

hints.en: information is uncountable.
Uncountable nouns have no plural.

explanation.he: information, advice, furniture, homework לא מקבלים s באנגלית, גם אם בעברית יש רבים ('מידע', 'עצות').
explanation.en: information, advice, furniture, homework never take -s in English.

items.audioText: Can you send me the information about the course?

items.prompt: We bought new ___ for the living room.

hints.en: furniture is uncountable in English.

hints.he: רוצים לספור? a piece of furniture.
hints.en: To count it: a piece of furniture.

explanation.he: furniture = רהיטים, אבל באנגלית זו מילה שלא סופרים. אין furnitures.
explanation.en: furniture is uncountable. There is no furnitures.

items.audioText: We bought new furniture for the living room.

items.prompt: The farmer has twenty ___.

hints.en: Some words don't change in the plural.
Like fish.

explanation.he: sheep נשאר sheep גם ברבים, כמו fish ו־deer.
explanation.en: sheep stays sheep in the plural, like fish and deer.

items.audioText: The farmer has twenty sheep.

items.prompt: Put the ___ and forks on the table. (knife)

feedback.he: מילים שמסתיימות ב־fe או f מקבלות ves: knives.
feedback.en: Words ending in -fe or -f often take -ves: knives.

hints.en: leaf → leaves. knife → ?

explanation.he: knife → knives, wife → wives, leaf → leaves.
explanation.en: knife → knives, leaf → leaves.

items.audioText: Put the knives and forks on the table.

items.prompt: He drives very ___.

hints.en: How does he drive? We describe a verb.
To describe a verb, add -ly.

explanation.he: שם תואר מתאר שם עצם (a careful driver). תואר הפועל מתאר פועל (drives carefully). careful + ly = carefully.
explanation.en: An adjective describes a noun. An adverb describes a verb: drives carefully.

items.audioText: He drives very carefully.

items.prompt: She speaks English very ___.

hints.en: We describe how she speaks.

hints.he: good הוא שם תואר. מה תואר הפועל שלו?
